captions.detailed: A cold-press smoothie blender featuring a wide, tapered rectangular base in black plastic with an orange control dial on the front-left. A transparent, wide-mouth polycarbonate jar with a dark grey handle sits on top of the base. Inside the jar, a six-blade cross assembly is visible at the bottom, and a thick black screw-top lid seals the top opening.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cold-press smoothie blender with a wide rectangular base, a translucent wide-mouth jar with a handle, an internal multi-blade assembly, and a screw-top lid. The base should feature a rotary dial, and the lid and blades should be modeled as separate, rotatable parts.
captions.factory: The base is created using a tapered box with filleted edges, combined with a cylindrical coupling and a front-mounted cylinder for the dial. The jar is constructed from a hollowed-out rectangular extrusion with a swept handle on its side. Inside, the blade assembly is made of intersecting thin boxes centered on a small cylinder. The lid is modeled as a thick cylinder with a decorative inner recess and outer ribbing.
